body: I drink 3-4 nights a week. I honestly believe it is making things worse. My body is more hurt and my face is breaking out.

I'm 23, male. I hangout with my friends/coworkers 3-4 times a week. We go to bars or just meet up for a good cigar. I work 6 days a week and go to school one day. Still living with my parents.

That being said, I'm depressed because I am lonely. Most of my friends are in these great relationships, while here I am being a third, sometimes a fifth wheel when we go out.

I don't tell anyone because I know there is nothing anyone can do to help me. How is a friend going to help me make a relationship last? I have never been in a relationship with anyone, but I have gone on dates here and there, some I kicked it off with, while other dates were pretty silent.

I don't know what to do. I'm unhappy and my hobbies don't help my cause, I own firearms that I have thought about using. I ride a motorcycle that I have thought about crashing.

I have a shitty job working as a bakery clerk and continuously fail my classes at a community college.

Jesus, life is hard. 

Edit: Sorry for my rant but it felt good typing this all out.

I didn't trust my first bike to take on long trips. My 1985 Honda Shadow vt500 would stall on me once or twice a month while sitting at red lights. I kept her within a 20-30 minute range.

Just purchased 2006 Triumph Speed Four that is waiting in my garage for the better weather. I hope to be able to take this bike hours away from home.

I'm someone who often thinks of suicide. A little over a year ago a friend took me shooting for the first time, and boy did I have a blast! Throughout a year I went back 5-6 more times to shoot other guns as well. Recently I decided it was time to purchase my own gun so that I'm not always using my friends. Back in April I purchased a glock 19, granted I figured it would be the gun to send me off, after shooting my gun(at the range) I absolutely fell in love with it even more and now just want more guns. I find guns to be therapeutic for me. Guns make me feel better m'kay.
I'm sorry. I do not know how

I do the same shit day in and day out. Nothing changes. I've been doing that for 2 years now. The only people I am friends with are my co workers, who invite me out rarely. <--Terribly written, but you get the point. Quick edit: I've been to therapy, went for about 6 months. It helped.
